Formal notices shall be sent to the representative and registered office in the Parties table by recorded post,

same manner.

A party delayed by an event beyond reasonable control, including natural disaster, war, government action or

This Agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales. The parties shall attempt good-faith resolution for
